title: Cheese Quesadilla
description: Cheese Quesadilla made with simple ingredients.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add tortilla, scatter cheese on one half, and fold.
Cook for 2 minutes per side until golden and melted. Serve with salsa.

title: Tuna Salad Wrap
description: Tuna Salad Wrap made with simple ingredients.
steps: Mix tuna, mayonnaise, lemon juice, and pepper.
Place lettuce and tuna on the tortilla, fold in the sides, and roll tightly.

title: Microwave Loaded Nachos
description: Microwave Loaded Nachos made with simple ingredients.
ingredients: 1/3 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Spread chips on a microwave-safe plate; top with beans and cheese.
Microwave for 60 to 90 seconds until cheese melts. Add salsa and sour cream.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: Grilled Cheese Sandwich made with simple ingredients.
steps: Butter one side of each bread slice and sandwich cheese between the unbuttered sides.
Cook in a skillet over medium-low heat for about 3 minutes per side, until golden and melted.

title: Rotisserie Chicken Tacos
description: Rotisserie Chicken Tacos made with simple ingredients.
steps: Heat chicken with salsa in a skillet for 2 minutes until steaming hot.
Warm tortillas in the microwave for 20 seconds. Fill with chicken and avocado; squeeze lime on top.
notes: Uses ready-cooked rotisserie chicken; cooking chicken from raw is not included in the 7-minute total.

title: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwich
description: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwich made with simple ingredients.
steps: Toast the muffin while heating butter in a small skillet.
Beat the egg with salt and pepper. Pour into the skillet and cook until set, folding to fit the muffin.
Top the egg with cheese, let melt, and sandwich in the toasted muffin.

title: Hummus Veggie Pita
description: Hummus Veggie Pita made with simple ingredients.
steps: Cut the pita in half and open the pockets.
Spread hummus inside and fill with cucumber, tomato, spinach, and feta.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wrap
description: Buffalo Chicken Wrap made with simple ingredients.
steps: Mix chicken and buffalo sauce. Microwave in a covered microwave-safe bowl until steaming hot, about 1 to 2 minutes.
Spread ranch on the tortilla, add lettuce and chicken, fold in sides, and roll.
notes: Start with ready-cooked chicken; allow extra time if cooking chicken from raw.

title: Microwave Pizza Tortilla
description: Microwave Pizza Tortilla made with simple ingredients.
steps: Place tortilla on a microwave-safe plate. Spread sauce and top with mozzarella, pepperoni, and oregano.
Microwave for 60 to 90 seconds until cheese melts. Fold and serve.
notes: A soft pizza-style tortilla; microwaving does not produce a crisp pizza crust.

title: Peanut Sesame Noodles
description: Peanut Sesame Noodles made with simple ingredients.
steps: Bring a small saucepan of water to a boil while mixing peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, sesame oil, and warm water.
Cook the quick noodles for 3 minutes according to the package, then drain.
Toss noodles with the sauce and spring onion.
notes: Use noodles labeled for a 3-minute cook and a small amount of water or an electric kettle to stay within the 8-minute total.

title: Pancit Bihon
description: Filipino stir-fried rice noodles with chicken, cabbage, and carrots.
steps: Soak noodles in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain; slice vegetables while soaking.
Heat oil in a wok. Cook onion and garlic for 2 minutes, then add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through.
Add carrots and cabbage and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in stock and soy sauce; bring to a simmer. Add noodles and toss for 5 to 7 minutes until tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Check chicken is fully cooked and serve with calamansi or lemon.

title: Garlic Fried Rice (Sinangag)
description: Filipino garlic fried rice, a savory breakfast staple.
steps: Break up clumps in the chilled cooked rice.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Fry garlic for 2 minutes until light golden; reserve a spoonful for topping.
Add rice and stir-fry for 5 to 6 minutes until piping hot throughout. Season and top with reserved garlic.
notes: Uses rice cooked ahead of time and promptly refrigerated. The 13-minute total excludes cooking and chilling rice.

title: Margarita
description: A classic Margarita cocktail, served in a cocktail glass.
steps: Rub the rim of the glass with the lime slice to make the salt stick to it. Take care to moisten only the outer rim and sprinkle the salt on it. The salt should present to the lips of the imbiber and never mix into the cocktail. Shake the other ingredients with ice, then carefully pour into the glass.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.

title: Mojito
description: A classic Mojito cocktail, served in a highball glass.
steps: Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime juice. Add a splash of soda water and fill the glass with cracked ice. Pour the rum and top with soda water. Garnish and serve with straw.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.

title: Old Fashioned
description: A classic Old Fashioned cocktail, served in a old-fashioned glass.
steps:
Place sugar cube in old fashioned glass and saturate with bitters, add a dash of plain water. Muddle until dissolved.
Fill the glass with ice cubes and add whiskey.

Garnish with orange twist, and a cocktail cherry.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.

title: Negroni
description: A classic Negroni cocktail, served in a old-fashioned glass.
steps: Stir into glass over ice, garnish and serve.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.

title: Daiquiri
description: A classic Daiquiri cocktail, served in a cocktail glass.
steps: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled cocktail glass.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.

title: Whiskey Sour
description: A classic Whiskey Sour cocktail, served in a old-fashioned glass.
steps: Shake with ice. Strain into chilled glass, garnish and serve. If served 'On the rocks', strain ingredients into old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.

title: Cosmopolitan
description: A classic Cosmopolitan cocktail, served in a cocktail glass.
steps: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and double strain into large cocktail glass. Garnish with lime wheel.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.

title: Moscow Mule
description: A classic Moscow Mule cocktail, served in a copper mug.
steps: Combine vodka and ginger beer in a highball glass filled with ice. Add lime juice. Stir gently. Garnish.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.

title: Manhattan
description: A classic Manhattan cocktail, served in a cocktail glass.
steps: Stirred over ice, strained into a chilled glass, garnished, and served up.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.

title: Gin And Tonic
description: A classic Gin And Tonic cocktail, served in a highball glass.
steps: Pour the gin and the tonic water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Garnish with the lime wedge.
notes: Preparation time is an estimate; source does not specify timing.
